dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Post-traumatic encephalomalacia and gliosis of the left frontal lobe with right hemiplegia and frontal lobe behavioral syndrome

1. Post-traumatic epilepsy (complex partial or non-convulsive status) precipitating behavioral disturbance requiring restraint
2. Frontal lobe syndromic behavioral disturbance (disinhibition, personality change, anosognosia) from prior traumatic brain injury
3. Dissociative or functional neurological disorder superimposed on chronic post-traumatic changes
